# Living spec — fixture

Three ACTIVE requirements, and no superseded or withdrawn marker anywhere, so a
plain count of the bullets below is the active count. The check compares the
figure the page renders against that count; a marker here would make the two
legitimately differ and the comparison would stop meaning anything.

## Requirements

- **R1** — The fixture shall hold a countable number of active requirements.
- **R2** — The fixture shall name no absolute path, so it reads the same in a fresh clone.
- **R3** — The fixture shall be readable, so that making it unreadable is a change of state.
